parsed.explanation: The dossier documents strong, operating protections: constitutional gender-identity protection, anti-discrimination and hate-crime coverage, no-surgery gender recognition, a conversion-therapy ban, and protected bathroom access. Social data is favourable, with 84% rating the country good for gay people and violence victimisation at or below the regional low. Traveller-facing exposures are real but bounded. Prison practice shifted after 2013, yet a 2018 award documents state-implicated abuse, and a 2024 dissertation records residual birth-name misgendering and healthcare gaps, so custody is a lagging, documented exposure. A pending case alleges detention without individualised assessment and removal of an LGBTI asylum seeker, but no judgment exists. Police reporting is low and online hatred is elevated. The rating reflects a low-to-reduced tier, not a flawless record.
